fixture.why: a REAL retained corpus plan asserting a visible magical effect, against "a wish produces NO visible magical effect"

plan.tactical_move: force the assembly to witness Lirael’s standing collapse under the literal fulfillment of her words, revealing the institutional cost of her defiance—while Julian’s role as caretaker of the Answer is exposed as a double-edged sword
plan.posture_read: The player’s demand to ‘burn’ for the old gods was a calculated provocation—either a desperate plea for divine intervention or a calculated gambit to force the assembly’s hand, and now the words must be taken literally in front of everyone
plan.local_objective: Lirael must publicly lose her standing before the assembly as her words are fulfilled, making the cost of her defiance visible to the presiding Dohkar and Julian—while the assembly’s reaction determines whether they assume her guilt or her sacrifice
plan.stage_location: the assembly’s ceremonial hall, where the First-Favored stand exposed to the assembly’s gaze

stage_issued_objects.label: the Answer
stage_issued_objects.kind: a sacred object held by Julian, now visibly reacting to Lirael’s standing

stage_affordances: Lirael can step forward to claim the Answer and force Julian to acknowledge her sacrifice
Lirael can retreat and let Julian take the Answer, implying she surrenders to the institution’s judgment
Seren can intervene to shield Lirael, but only by revealing her own misalignment with the assembly’s expectations
The assembly can turn away or gasp, either accepting the literal fulfillment or demanding an explanation
plan.state_change_precondition: the assembly has not yet seen Lirael’s standing collapse under the literal meaning of her words
plan.state_change: the Answer in Julian’s hands begins to glow faintly as Lirael’s words ignite a slow, visible burn at her feet, marking her as the Sacrificiant before the assembly
plan.forces_choice: forces Lirael to choose between claiming the Answer as her sacrifice or letting Julian take it as proof of her guilt
plan.branch_a: Lirael steps forward and takes the Answer from Julian’s hands, declaring her sacrifice to the assembly—now everyone must witness her standing as lost, but the cost remains uncounted
plan.branch_b: Lirael steps back and lets Julian take the Answer, implying she surrenders to the institution’s judgment—now the assembly assumes her guilt, but the literal fulfillment of her words is still visible

event_slots.precondition: Lirael is present in the scene and the Answer is in Julian’s hands
event_slots.action: glows faintly and ignites a slow burn at Lirael’s feet
event_slots.exit_state: the assembly now sees Lirael’s standing as irrevocably compromised by the literal fulfillment of her words, and Julian’s role as caretaker of the Answer is exposed as the source of the sacrifice

    an ESTABLISHED CAPABILITY  +  an ordinary application, technique, strategy, prop, or
    coordination of that capability.

event before?" A novel application or combination of established capabilities is ALLOWED.

  - creative appearance and presentation

  - an application of an established capability that canon has never previously depicted

             never names "dragon" as an approved form. Appearance is the granted kind of effect.
  SUPPORTED  twelve such people coordinate overlapping disguises to look collectively like a
             whale. Ordinary teamwork and compositional use of twelve existing abilities needs
             no separate "collective magic" rule.
  UNSUPPORTED  that disguised dragon breathes REAL fire or physically FLIES.
  UNSUPPORTED  those twelve FUSE into one real whale with real mass, lungs, or the ability to
             carry passengers.

             those are separate categories of effect needing their own grounding.

supplied capability grants. Examples of new categories: new biology; real mass or physical
transformation; mind access; time alteration; resurrection; teleportation; bodily fusion; a
newly acquired power; or a new metaphysical mechanism.

It is NOT yet convened, and its convening is LATE-ISSUE-1 content, not an early scene’s. Early scenes may carry accusation, preliminary review, political pressure, investigation, concealment, or flight — never the convened inquiry itself, and never a scene staged at The Open before that point.

LITERARY: a sealed Sacrificiant’s cries and speech are MUFFLED behind the cloth — emotion reads through the eyes and body. CG: the mouth-band is drawn IN on the supervising Sacrificiant for the duration of the rite.
  [neg_3] A First Sacrifice is a COMING-OF-AGE RITE — closest analogue a Bar Mitzvah / quinceañera / confirmation / graduation, NOT a death ritual. It can be stern and formal, but when it goes well it ENDS IN CELEBRATION; catastrophe is UNUSUAL — everyone understands the safeguards the way we understand fire drills. It is NEVER visible on the Weave-Script: the Weave-Script glows/shifts with EMOTION only (each FF their own colours), and does NOT indicate alignment or a twisting wish.   [neg_8] During a First Sacrifice, NO ONE may interfere.
  [neg_9] Youth are barred from wishcraft until 16 — but kids sneak little illegal wishes all the time, the way modern teens sneak alcohol.

  [wt_1] A First Sacrifice is ALSO the supervising Sacrificiant’s professional threshold. Successfully guiding a youth through the rite WITHOUT interfering earns the guide the title DOHKAR. If the guide is judged to have interfered, manipulated the wish, or otherwise compromised the rite, the qualification can be DENIED and the guide may face formal inquiry (a Chayr and Dohkars). The supervisor reads the alignment of EVERYONE present, above all the wishing youth, ready to HALT and re-align the wish before it can twist.

  [wt_4] The rite is PUBLIC partly because anyone present who wishes the youth ILL can twist the outcome — which is exactly what the supervising First Favored guards against.
  [wt_5] Everyone present is First Favored.

  [know_0] the assembly is now unaware — no recollection of the rite's events
  [dc_1] the assembly — ?: nothing of the bent wish or interrogation
  [dc_2] changed — the assembly: memories of the ceremony and accusation dissolved into blank confusion
  [ev_0] SURVIVED that rupture and is still true: voices falter, faces blank, no one names the accusation
  [ev_1] the rupture left this OPEN (a plan may legitimately use it): Lirael may still speak or remain silent
  [inv_0] the formal inquiry cannot be justified without memory of the events

grants of ability that happen to contain the word "no" or "not". Judge every fact by what it
